name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 23, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Gary Vanderford of North Coast Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring the week of September 11-18, 2011, "Tri-City Medical Center Week" in the City of Vista for providing 50 years of health care to the community.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ending June 30, 2011 (CC)
C4.
Boys and Girls Club of Vista Special Event Banner (CC)
C5.
All-Way Stop - Connecticut Avenue at Redlands Street (CC)
C6.
Amendment to Lease of 242 Vista Village Drive (CC)
C7.
Design-Build Contracts Ordinance (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Naming of the Brengle Terrace Park Interior Driveway (CC)
D2.
Management Options for Central Vista Business Improvement District (CC)
D3.
Alternative Voluntary Redevelopment Program (CC/CDC)
1.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2011- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California Authorizing the City of Vista to Participate in the Alternative Voluntary Redevelopment Program, Subject to Certain Conditions and Reservations."
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , authorizing the Mayor to Execute a Remittance Agreement with the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista Pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34194.2
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , authorizing the Chairperson to Execute a Remittance Agreement with the City of Vista Pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34194.2
4.
Adopt Community Development Commission No. Resolution 2011- , reducing its Allocation to the Low and Moderate Income Housing Fund for the 2011-12 Fiscal Year and Making Certain Findings and Determinations.
D4.
Enforceable Obligation Payment Schedule (CDC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
